fit.gap_handling_summary: Gaps (AWS, Terragrunt, mTLS, IoT, JVM) are not faked; the letter openly says the cloud experience is Azure-based. Closest real experience (Terraform landing zones, network design, security baselines) is shown well.

issues: Location (Rotterdam, Netherlands) dropped from the header although it is in the source CV
Helpdesk Technician entry has no description (acceptable for an old role)

ats.reason: Clean, ordered text with standard headings and all requirements the candidate really has in searchable terms; no stuffing. Unmet keywords (AWS, Terragrunt, mTLS) honestly absent, and 'monitoring' appears only as 'Azure Monitor'.

issues: Largely repeats CV bullets rather than adding motivation or personality
Company information (engineering-led, teams own systems end to end, new train fleet) barely used beyond the ad
Does not address secure train-to-cloud communication or stakeholder work with manufacturers
Slightly awkward 'matching your acceptance of other major clouds alongside AWS'
strengths: Concrete metrics and relevant Terraform networking work
Ties experience to the train-to-backend platform
No stale framing from the old IT Administrator letter

spacing_issues: CV page 1 leaves roughly the bottom quarter empty before the page break
Cover letter ends with a large empty lower third
issues: Uneven page break in CV wastes space on page 1

fluency_and_tone_issues: 'matching your acceptance of other major clouds alongside AWS' is stiff
'These projects demonstrate both delivery leadership and attention to reliable operations' is generic

notes_facts_used: Career break Mar 2020 - Aug 2022 for family care
Feb 2024 - Feb 2025 study period, Terraform Associate, Proxmox homelab, bootcamp
AKS operations scope vs developer-owned manifests
Python basic scripting, Go only for Terratest

requests.request: I'd rather leave those details out.

evaluation.summary: A truthful, well-structured English CV and letter that surface the candidate's real Terraform, Azure networking and pipeline work with accurate metrics and handle both employment gaps honestly using the notes. Gaps against the ad (AWS, Terragrunt, mTLS, IoT, JVM) are not faked, and the letter openly states the Azure-only background. Weaknesses: the Rotterdam location was dropped, the CV page break leaves empty space on page 1, and the letter mostly restates CV bullets with little use of company information or the train-to-cloud security scope.
